intro: Dodge bullets, defeat the enemy, and face the incident of the Scarlet Mist
description:
Touhou Koumakyou from the Touhou makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2 .
Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo.

The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode, where you can take on the game with unlimited lives.

You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay.
*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

This product is for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on the Nintendo Switch 2 , but a separate Nintendo Switch 2 -exclusive version, “Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil,” is also available.
Save data and downloadable content are not compatible between the two versions. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Please note that there is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack for this title.
